propositions: Five test modules repeatedly construct equivalent virgin git-backed stores in function-scoped fixtures, consuming 103+ worker-seconds aggregate across 260 spans where test bodies account for only a fraction

Discriminating runtime experiments show real store initialization takes 0.4–1.4s but isolated per-test copies cost 0.03–0.04s each, yielding 12–24x speedup from template reuse without changing assertion semantics

Precedent ticket peculiar-calmy-bubblefish and consensus from Django, Rails, and GitLab demonstrate that session-scoped templates with isolated per-test copies and proper isolation sentinels are a standard practice for expensive fixtures

Proposed fix adds per-test copy isolation at fixture boundaries while preserving safety contracts: per-test copies must have disjoint refs, worktree paths, identities, and caches; templates must remain virgin; from-scratch initialization and recovery tests are excluded
